summary: Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2016-C3 filed an 8-K reporting the transfer of special servicing duties for the 101 Hudson mortgage loan from Greystone Servicing Company LLC to C-IV Asset Management LLC, effective September 1, 2026. This is a routine servicing arrangement change under the pool servicing agreement, not an M&A or corporate special situation. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved; the event is administrative and asset-level within a securitization. The filing includes an assignment and assumption agreement exhibit. There is no special-situation angle; this is standard ABS servicing logistics reporting.
